summary.headline: June closed $970K on the spring buying peak; HIH softened seasonally to 76; MQL/SQL inflated by an offline lifecycle import.
summary.body: June's story is revenue: $970,129 closed won across 34 deals (63% win rate by count, 83% by dollar) — the strongest month this fiscal year and on-cycle for the spring-summer district buying peak, though 82% of it came from two deals (Idea Public Schools $641K, Yonkers $160K). Genuine demand softened as expected heading into summer: HIH came in at 76, down 22% from May's 101, which is seasonal, not a signal problem. MQL and SQL totals are inflated by a large offline lifecycle import (95% OFFLINE-sourced, no UTM); the product-tagged funnel is roughly flat versus May (IJ 54 HIH, 30 SQL). Two watch items: UTM completeness collapsed to 2.1%, and Medium-segment deals lost the month (3 won vs 5 lost, $114K in losses).

brand_lift.note: These are Google Search numbers, not social engagement — how often our brand and channels surface when people search. YouTube and Instagram were verified as GSC Social Signals properties on Jul 30, 2026; collection starts at verification (no backfill). First WoW read: week of Aug 17. First clean MoM: early-October digest (September vs August). LinkedIn has no GSC connector — it's owned by Microsoft and isn't integrated with Google.

weekly_signal.narrative: MQL came in at 33 this week (Jul 27–Aug 2), down 17% from 40 the prior week, consistent with the seasonal transition into August. SQL and Opp followed at 23 and 22 — all three metrics in the typical summer-floor range with no structural signal behind the pullback. IJ continues to drive most lower-funnel movement (6 of 23 SQLs), while Single/Small inbound accounts for the majority of new MQLs. Open pipeline holds at 30 district and 24 school deals heading into back-to-school season.
